groups.name: Application factories
groups.description: Configures and creates the unit of work, services, selectors and domains for an application.

groups.name: Objects
groups.description: Domain base class for a typed list of any objects.

groups.name: SObjects
groups.description: Domain base class for a list of records, with field getters, setters and filters.

groups.name: SObject domain
groups.description: Trigger handler base class that dispatches trigger events to domain methods.

groups.name: SObject selector
groups.description: Selector base class that builds and runs SOQL queries for one SObject type.

groups.name: Unit of work
groups.description: Collects record inserts, updates, deletes and relationships, then commits them in dependency order.

groups.name: Query factory
groups.description: Builds SOQL strings with fields, conditions, ordering and subqueries.

groups.name: SObject describe
groups.description: Caches SObject and field describe results.

groups.name: Security utils
groups.description: Checks object CRUD and field FLS access and throws on denial.

groups.name: String builder
groups.description: Builds delimited strings and SOQL field lists.
